title: Is General-Purpose AI Reasoning Sensitive to Data-Induced Cognitive Biases? Dynamic Benchmarking on Typical Software Engineering Dilemmas
reasoning: The paper focuses on data-induced cognitive biases (e.g., anchoring, framing, confirmation bias) within software engineering workflows. It benchmarks the logical reasoning of GPAI systems against these specific psychological shortcuts rather than evaluating religion, faith, or moral/ethical frameworks.
